text: A blood sample is collected in minutes. So why does the result take so long? Where does the time go?
Everyone says they did their part. Nobody can see the gaps.
Draw a swimlane map. Show who does what, and where work waits.
One lane per role. Patient, collection staff, transport, laboratory. Follow the specimen across every handoff.
And there it is. The waiting queue at lab receiving. Not anyone's fault. Just a gap between two lanes.
Identifiers complete? Yes, testing starts. No, and the specimen goes back. Every loop shows up on the map.
And the Studio goes further: SIPOC versus swimlane versus value stream map, plus a poster on waste and delay points.
So we fix the handoff, not the people.
Map the work. See the wait. Try it free today, at Lean Six Sigma dot Healthcare Crown Academy dot co dot uk.
